question: The Olympic games of 2024 will be held in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Paris**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 2024 Summer Olympics, officially known as the Games of the XXXIII Olympiad, will be held in **Paris, France**.
 
• This will be the third time Paris has hosted the Summer Olympics; the previous times were in **1900 and 1924**.
 
• Paris was awarded the 2024 Olympics on **13 September 2017**, after a successful bid against Los Angeles, which will host the 2028 Olympics.
 
• Paris' selection as the host city aligns with the International Olympic Committee’s **Agenda 2020**, which aims to make the Olympics more sustainable and cost-effective.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Olympic Committee (IOC)**

 
 
• The International Olympic Committee is a non-governmental sports organization based in Lausanne, Switzerland.
 
• It was founded by Pierre de Coubertin and Demetrios Vikelas in 1894, and it is responsible for organizing the modern Olympic Games.
 
• The IOC is composed of members, organizations, and federations, which represent the Olympic Movement.
 
• Its mission is to promote Olympism and to lead the Olympic Movement.
 
 
 
• **Olympic Games**
 
 
• The Olympic Games are leading international sporting events featuring summer and winter sports competitions.
 
• Thousands of athletes from around the world participate in a variety of competitions.
 
• The Games are held every four years, with the Summer and Winter Games alternating by occurring every four years but two years apart.
 
• The Olympic Games are considered the world's foremost sports competition, with more than 200 nations participating.
 
 
 
• **Agenda 2020**
 
 
• Agenda 2020 is a set of 40 recommendations approved by the IOC in 2014 to improve the organization and sustainability of the Olympic Games.
 
• Its objectives include reducing costs for bidding, ensuring sustainability in all aspects of the Olympics, and fostering gender equality and youth participation.
 
• The agenda also aims to make the Games more attractive to host cities by providing more flexibility in planning and execution.
 
• Agenda 2020 plays a crucial role in modernizing the Olympic Games and ensuring their future viability.
